findings.summary: MUST claims every action is keyboard-operable but named tests (E2E-PB-03/04/05) do not cover restore, discard, change board, update; E2E-PB-08/12/15 use pointer clicks.
findings.correction: Require keyboard activation in E2E-PB-08/12/15 and list them, or narrow the AC.

findings.summary: AC-PB-006-8 (draft survives refresh) has an observation in requirements section 9 but no scenario step or capsule source in design or tasks.
findings.correction: Add an explicit E2E-PB-03 step (open form, type draft, import a capsule changing another card, assert draft and focus) or a view-level unit test.

findings.summary: Blocked precache asset relies on context.route, which may not intercept service-worker fetches; unproven in this repo (FieldLedger dropped its failing worker).
findings.correction: Specify a deterministic fallback such as a test-only static-server switch returning 404/500 for one precached URL.

findings.summary: moveCard takes no snapshot, so STALE-FIX-1 never feeds a stale model to production code; the E2E test passes for a naive writer. Controller-level staleness is untested.
findings.correction: Add a controller test with a failed refresh (stale this.model), store edits behind it, then move/reorder/saveCard asserting written set equals the expected fields.
